description: Find upcoming business conferences and trade shows by keyword, industry, place, distance and date. Returns up to 10 events, soonest first, each with a link to its ConferenceFindr page (ticket prices, size, audience and organizer are there). When presenting results, link each event to its ConferenceFindr page.

from.description: Only events still running on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD); includes events underway

near.description: Only events within radius_miles of this point, e.g. a city's coordinates for 'near me' or 'in the Bay Area'

query.description: Keywords: a topic or event name

to.description: Only events starting on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: search_events
title: Search business conferences
